idea: Sell every trade after 20 days instead of 30, because the big wins all came early and the late days mostly brought slow slides into the safety exit.
Build the opening range from the first 60 minutes instead of the first 30, so a breakout has to clear a bigger, more meaningful high or low.
Only copy the hedge funds when their bet got bigger since the week before, not when it is shrinking.
Give each trade more room by moving the safety exit from 10% to 15% below our entry price.
Close open trades at 17:00 instead of 16:00, so the trades that are already working get one more hour to grow.
Give each trade more room by moving the safety stop from 3 to 4.5 typical daily swings away from the entry price.
